purpose: Fresh outside-building rear ground cross-check against the shipping regular host, not a wall seat, roof fit, present-day survey or approval. Earlier withheld point body remains sealed.

frame.axesText: Positive U northeast along longest track-side eave (edge 6 to 5); positive V northwest, away from track.

copc.gpsTimeIsolation: Validate exact unique PointSourceId / GPS-time bits within this new study; earlier sealed source membership cannot be inferred from XY and any absent proof stays explicitly unverified.

rules.fit: One pooled median signed CGVD2013-minus-N112 residual only on this study’s fit blocks; deduplicate pulses, no tuning or orientation per block.
rules.reservedScoring: Use exact fit scalar per reserved row. Report raw class counts, per-group residual median and p90 absolute, span, N56 comparison (not a fitted substitute), grounds coverage counts. No geometry change even on success.
rules.minimumSupport: 12 unique pulses per group; classification exactly 2, reject synthetic, overlap and withheld points; no numeric claim if sparse or if fit/reserved share pulse. No explicit independent overlap claims without blind custodian.
rules.stationSourceGap: New rear control is spatially separate from declared older reviewed V≤16.6 plus guard; it remains rear only and cannot authorize any precise front wall, pillar, grade, or terrain correction.
